gutendex.name: Project Gutenberg
gutendex.description: ~75k public-domain titles via the Gutendex JSON API. Downloads go directly to gutenberg.org file servers.
gutendex.geo_block_notes: gutenberg.org geo-blocks Germany; aleph mirror is the fallback candidate.

standardebooks.name: Standard Ebooks
standardebooks.description: ~1k meticulously formatted public-domain titles over OPDS 1.2. NOTE (verified 2026-08-21): the full OPDS feed is now a Patrons Circle benefit; access = patron email + blank password. The New Releases RSS/Atom feed remains anonymous.

openlibrary.name: Open Library
openlibrary.description: Metadata + covers layer (M1). Search API is anonymous.

annas-archive.name: Anna's Archive
annas-archive.description: Donator-key API preferred; scrape fallback. Opt-in only with user credentials.

z-library.name: Z-Library
z-library.description: eAPI login flow with SSO session survival across mirrors. User supplies email, password, and mirror base URL. Opt-in only with disclaimer acknowledgment.
